title: Drive J1-J3: ring pins
note:
Press the 21 dowels into the housing ring.
Tap them flush with the ring's top face.

title: Drive J1-J3: output flange
note:
Press the output pins into the flange, then the small bearing
into the flange's centre seat (from the pin side).

title: Drive J1-J3: bearings in cover and cap
note:
Press one small bearing into the back cover and the big bearing
into the output cap. Push on the outer ring only.

title: Drive J1-J3: input shaft
note:
Slide one bearing over each eccentric: the first from the pulley end,
the second from the other end.

title: Drive J1-J3: cover, shaft, ring
note:
Shaft into the cover bearing, then lower the ring with its pins
into the cover's pin holes.

title: Drive J1-J3: discs
note:
Drop in disc A, then disc B. Turn the shaft a little until each disc
falls flat between the pins.

title: Drive J1-J3: output flange and cap
note:
Feed the flange pins through both discs, onto the shaft's front journal.
Cap on top. Keep the stack together until it is bolted down.

title: Drive J4: ring pins
note:
Press the 16 dowels into the housing ring.
Tap them flush with the ring's top face.

title: Drive J4: output flange
note:
Press the output pins into the flange, then the small bearing
into the flange's centre seat (from the pin side).

title: Drive J4: bearings in cover and cap
note:
Press one small bearing into the back cover and the big bearing
into the output cap. Push on the outer ring only.

title: Drive J4: input shaft
note:
Slide one bearing over each eccentric: the first from the pulley end,
the second from the other end.

title: Drive J4: cover, shaft, ring
note:
Shaft into the cover bearing, then lower the ring with its pins
into the cover's pin holes.

title: Drive J4: discs
note:
Drop in disc A, then disc B. Turn the shaft a little until each disc
falls flat between the pins.

title: Drive J4: output flange and cap
note:
Feed the flange pins through both discs, onto the shaft's front journal.
Cap on top. Keep the stack together until it is bolted down.

title: Base: electronics on the floor
note: Pi 4, the controller perfboard and the buck converter go on their standoffs.

title: Base: J1 drive
note:
Drive on top of the base, bolts from the cap side,
nuts in the pockets under the top plate.

title: Base: J1 belt and sensor (from below)
note:
Pulley onto the shaft hex (grub screw), magnet cap onto the rod, motor on its shelf,
belt on, shelf up onto its posts, sensor bridge last.

title: Base: close it
note:
OLED, 3 buttons, DC jack and switch into the shell. Wire up (see the
electronics sheets), then screw the floor on.

title: Turntable
note:
Grease the race, lay in the 64 balls, set the turntable on the J1 clamp.
Screws go through turntable and clamp into the drive's hub.

title: Tower: J2 drive and motor
note:
Drive against the tower plate (6 bolts, nuts on the far side).
Motor on the drive side, shaft through the slotted holes.

title: Tower: J2 belt and sensor
note:
On the back of the tower: pulley, magnet cap, belt, then the sensor bridge.
Slide the motor to tension the belt, then tighten.

title: Tower onto the turntable
note: Four M4 bolts through the tower foot and the turntable.

title: Upper arm: tube and fittings
note:
Cut the 15x15x1.5 tube to 190 mm. Push it into both fittings,
then bolt across each socket.

title: Upper arm: J3 drive and motor
note:
Drive under the elbow plate, motor under the tail plate.
Belt side stays on top.

title: Upper arm: J3 belt and sensor
note:
Pulleys, the long belt, magnet cap, sensor bridge.
Slide the motor along its slots to tension the belt.

title: Forearm: tube and fittings
note: Same as the upper arm: 190 mm tube, 2 bolts per socket.

title: Forearm: J4 drive, motor, belt, sensor
note:
Small drive at the wrist end, motor on the tail.
Belt, pulleys and sensor bridge on the other side of the plate.

title: Wrist: roll bearing, hub, roll motor
note:
Bearing into the shelf pocket from above, hub through it, then the pancake
motor on top: its D-shaft slides into the hub.

title: Gripper: jaws
note: Press two LM6UU bushings into each jaw.

title: Gripper: rods, motor, pinion
note:
Rods through the end wall and both jaws. Motor on the plate, pinion on its shaft
with both jaws at full open. Home switch on the end wall.

title: Gripper onto the wrist
note: Three screws through the hub flange into the gripper's top plate.

title: Upper arm onto J2
note:
Upper arm's round plate onto the J2 clamp: six screws through plate and clamp
into the J2 hub.

title: Forearm onto J3
note: Forearm's round plate onto the J3 clamp, six screws.

title: Wrist onto J4
note: Wrist bracket onto the J4 clamp, four M2.5 screws into the J4 hub.

title: Camera pole
note:
Cut the 20 mm tube to 669 (pole) and 277 mm (boom).
Foot, pole, tee, boom, mount, camera plate. Level the camera with the tilt bolt.

title: Baseplate
note:
Arm base, chessboard and camera pole on one plywood plate. Board edge 100 mm from
the base axis, centred; pole at X -300, Y 300. Bolt base and pole foot down.
